step.script: For launches and landings at the same height, range depends on launch speed and angle. Ignore air resistance and keep speed fixed.
The normalized range follows this curve: it rises, reaches a maximum, then falls as the launch becomes steeper.
Sine reaches one when twice the launch angle is ninety degrees. Therefore, forty-five degrees gives the greatest range.

checkpoint.question: With the same launch speed, would increasing the angle from 45 degrees to 60 degrees increase or decrease range?
checkpoint.expected_gist: Decrease: 45 degrees gives the maximum range.

step.script: Complementary angles give equal ranges. Thirty and sixty degrees land equally far away, though sixty degrees gives a higher, longer flight.

ops.content: Same speed, same landing height, no air drag
